title: Ishontirish va muzokara
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ethos, logos va pathos yordamida ishontiruvchi taklif tuzasiz, muzokaraning oltita bosqichini boshqarasiz, if, provided that va unless bilan shartli yon berasiz hamda rad javobini diplomatik iboralar bilan ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: Ishontirish san’ati
board: Lesson: Persuasion and negotiation
(Ishontirish va muzokara)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda tez nutq va aksentlarni tushunishni o‘rgandik. Bugun tinglovchidan so‘zlovchiga aylanamiz. Ishontirish fikrni o‘zgartiradi, muzokara esa ikki tomon ham rozi bo‘ladigan kelishuvni topadi. Dars oxirida ishontirish usullarini qo‘llaysiz, muzokara bosqichlarini boshqarasiz, shart bilan yon berasiz va “yo‘q” ni diplomatik ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time you learnt to catch fast speech. Today you'll use your own voice to persuade, to bargain, and to say no without burning bridges.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar tez nutqni ilg‘ashni o‘rgandingiz. Bugun o‘z ovozingiz bilan ishontirasiz, savdolashasiz va ko‘priklarni yoqmasdan “yo‘q” deysiz.

scenes.title: Ethos, logos, pathos
board: Ethos = credibility (Why trust you?)
Logos = logic and evidence
Pathos = emotion and values

examples.t: In my ten years in logistics, I've seen this work.
examples.uz: Logistikadagi o‘n yillik tajribamda bu ishlaganini ko‘rganman.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: ishontirish usullari. Aristotel davridan beri uchta asos bor. Ethos: ishonchlilik, ya’ni nega sizga ishonish kerak, tajribangiz va halolligingiz. Logos: mantiq va dalil, raqamlar, misollar. Pathos: his-tuyg‘u va qadriyatlar. Kuchli nutq uchalasini birlashtiradi. Faqat his-tuyg‘u manipulyatsiyaga o‘xshaydi, faqat raqam esa zerikarli.
scenes.say: Ethos: why should they trust you? Logos: what's the evidence? Pathos: why should they care? Strong arguments use all three.
scenes.say_uz: Ethos: nega sizga ishonishlari kerak? Logos: dalil nima? Pathos: nega ular qayg‘urishi kerak? Kuchli dalillar uchalasini ishlatadi.

scenes.title: Dalil va uchlik qoidasi
board: Rule of three: faster, cheaper, safer
Specific > vague: cut costs by 12%
not: a lot of savings

examples.t: The new system is faster, cheaper and safer.
examples.uz: Yangi tizim tezroq, arzonroq va xavfsizroq.

examples.t: It cut delivery times by 18% in six months.
examples.uz: U olti oyda yetkazib berish vaqtini 18 foizga qisqartirdi.

scenes.say_native: Logos uchun ikki qoida. Birinchi: aniq bo‘ling. “A lot of savings” o‘rniga “we cut costs by twelve per cent” deng, aniq raqam ishonch uyg‘otadi. Ikkinchi: uchlik qoidasi. Ingliz ritorikasida uchta element ritmik va esda qolarli eshitiladi: faster, cheaper, safer. Ikkita kam, to‘rtta esa ko‘p tuyuladi. Taqdimot va muzokarada buni ongli ravishda ishlating.
scenes.say: The new system is faster, cheaper and safer. It cut delivery times by eighteen per cent in six months. Three benefits, one hard number.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi tizim tezroq, arzonroq va xavfsizroq. U olti oyda yetkazib berish vaqtini o‘n sakkiz foizga qisqartirdi. Uchta foyda, bitta aniq raqam.

scenes.title: Ularning foydasi haqida gapiring
board: Features → benefits
✓ This means you’ll...
✓ What this gives your team is...

examples.t: This means your staff will spend less time on paperwork.
examples.uz: Bu xodimlaringiz qog‘ozbozlikka kamroq vaqt sarflaydi degani.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘p odam o‘z taklifining xususiyatlarini sanaydi. Ishontiruvchi odam esa tinglovchining foydasini aytadi. “Our software has automatic reports” xususiyat. “This means your managers will save two hours a week” esa foyda. “This means you’ll”, “What this gives you is”, “The real advantage for you is” iboralari diqqatni sizdan ularga o‘tkazadi.
scenes.say: Our software has automatic reports. So what? This means your managers will save two hours a week. Now they're listening.
scenes.say_uz: Dasturimizda avtomatik hisobotlar bor. Xo‘sh, nima bo‘pti? Bu menejerlaringiz haftasiga ikki soat tejaydi degani. Endi ular tinglayapti.

scenes.title: Ritorik savol va ramka
board: Rhetorical question: Can we afford to wait?
Gain frame: you’ll save £2,000 a year
Loss frame: you’re losing £2,000 a year
scenes.say_native: Ikki kuchli vosita. Ritorik savol javob kutmaydi, u tinglovchini xulosaga yetaklaydi: “Can we really afford to wait another year?”. Ramka esa bir xil faktni foyda yoki yo‘qotish sifatida beradi: “you’ll save” va “you’re losing”. Yo‘qotish ramkasi ko‘pincha kuchliroq ta’sir qiladi. Oldingi darsdagi raqam ramkasini eslang.
scenes.say: Can we really afford to wait another year? Right now, you're losing two thousand pounds a year. Same fact, sharper frame.
scenes.say_uz: Yana bir yil kutishga haqiqatan qurbimiz yetadimi? Hozir siz yiliga ikki ming funt yo‘qotyapsiz. Fakt o‘sha, ramka o‘tkirroq.

scenes.title: O‘zbek madaniyati bilan qiyos
board: Uzbek style: long respectful preamble, hospitality
English business style: brief small talk → point
Respect = being clear and concise
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek madaniyatida muzokara ko‘pincha uzun hurmat iboralari, hol-ahvol va mehmondorchilik bilan boshlanadi, asosiy masala keyinroq keladi. Ingliz ish madaniyatida qisqa small talk dan keyin tezroq mavzuga o‘tiladi. Bu qo‘pollik emas: aniq va qisqa gapirish ularning nazarida hurmat, chunki siz ularning vaqtini qadrlaysiz. Boshqa madaniyatlar bilan ishlaganda bu farqni moslang.
scenes.say: Shall we get down to business? In British and American meetings, that line often comes within the first few minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga o‘tsak bo‘ladimi? Britaniya va Amerika uchrashuvlarida bu gap ko‘pincha birinchi daqiqalardayoq aytiladi.

scenes.title: Bosim o‘tkazish
board: ✗ You must accept this offer.
✗ This is the best price, believe me.
✓ I think you’ll find this works well for you.
✓ The figures speak for themselves.
scenes.say_native: Tipik xato: ishontirishni bosim bilan adashtirish. “You must accept” yoki “believe me” ingliz quloqqa tajovuzkor va hatto shubhali eshitiladi. “Believe me” ko‘pincha teskari ta’sir qiladi: tinglovchi nega ishonishim kerak deb o‘ylaydi. Uning o‘rniga dalilni gapirtiring: “I think you’ll find this works well for you” yoki “The figures speak for themselves”.
scenes.say: You must accept this offer. Believe me. That sounds desperate. Try: I think you'll find this works well for you.
scenes.say_uz: Siz bu taklifni qabul qilishingiz shart. Menga ishoning. Bu umidsiz eshitiladi. Bunday deng: O‘ylaymanki, bu sizga yaxshi mos keladi.

scenes.title: Mashq: ishontiruvchiroq qiling
board: 1 Our course has 40 video lessons.
2 You must sign today.
3 The new office is good.
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif gapni ishontiruvchiroq qiling. Birinchisida xususiyatni foydaga aylantiring. Ikkinchisida bosimni olib tashlab, dalil yoki yo‘qotish ramkasini ishlating. Uchinchisida “good” o‘rniga uchlik qoidasini qo‘llang. Ovoz chiqarib ayting yoki yozing. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: Make each sentence more persuasive. Turn features into benefits, replace pressure with reasons, and try the rule of three. Pause now.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni ishontiruvchiroq qiling. Xususiyatni foydaga, bosimni sababga aylantiring va uchlik qoidasini sinab ko‘ring. Hozir pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ishontirish
board: 1 This means you can learn at your own pace, anywhere.
2 If we sign today, the price is locked in before it rises.
3 It’s bigger, brighter and closer to the station.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “This means you can learn at your own pace, anywhere”, xususiyat foydaga aylandi. Ikkinchi: “If we sign today, the price is locked in before it rises”, bosim o‘rniga sabab va yo‘qotish ramkasi. Uchinchi: “It’s bigger, brighter and closer to the station”, uchlik qoidasi. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, shu uch usul bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: A benefit, a reason instead of pressure, and the rule of three.
scenes.say_uz: Foyda, bosim o‘rniga sabab va uchlik qoidasi.

scenes.title: Muzokaraning olti bosqichi
board: 1 Prepare  2 Open  3 Explore
4 Propose  5 Bargain  6 Close
Skipping stages = losing value
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: muzokara bosqichlari. Tayyorgarlik, ochilish, qiziqishlarni o‘rganish, taklif, savdolashish va yakunlash. Ko‘pchilik to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri taklifdan boshlaydi va qimmatli ma’lumotni yo‘qotadi. Har bir bosqichning o‘z tili bor, hozir ularni birma-bir ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Prepare, open, explore, propose, bargain, close. Most people jump straight to propose, and leave value on the table.
scenes.say_uz: Tayyorlan, och, o‘rgan, taklif qil, savdolash, yakunla. Ko‘pchilik to‘g‘ri taklifga sakraydi va qiymatni stolda qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Tayyorgarlik: maqsad va chegara
board: Target: what you hope for
Walk-away point: your limit
BATNA: your best alternative if there’s no deal
scenes.say_native: Tayyorgarlikda uchta narsani aniqlang. Target: nimaga erishishni xohlaysiz. Walk-away point: qaysi chegaradan keyin kelishuvdan voz kechasiz. BATNA, ya’ni best alternative to a negotiated agreement: kelishuv bo‘lmasa eng yaxshi muqobilingiz. Masalan, boshqa ish taklifi bo‘lsa, sizning BATNA kuchli. BATNA qanchalik kuchli bo‘lsa, shunchalik xotirjam muzokara olib borasiz.
scenes.say: Know your target, know your walk-away point, and know your BATNA. If you have another offer in your pocket, you negotiate very differently.
scenes.say_uz: Maqsadingizni, chegarangizni va BATNA ingizni biling. Cho‘ntagingizda boshqa taklif bo‘lsa, butunlay boshqacha muzokara qilasiz.

scenes.title: Ochilish va o‘rganish
board: Open: Thanks for making the time.
Explore: What’s most important to you here?
What would make this work for you?
Could you tell me a bit more about...?
scenes.say_native: Ochilishda qisqa, iliq gap: “Thanks for making the time”. Keyin eng muhim bosqich, o‘rganish. Ochiq savollar bering: “What’s most important to you here?”, “What would make this work for you?”. Ular qarama-qarshi tomonning haqiqiy qiziqishini ochadi: ba’zan ular uchun narx emas, muddat yoki sifat muhimroq.
scenes.say: Thanks for making the time. Before we talk numbers, what's most important to you here? Open questions uncover what really matters.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt ajratganingiz uchun rahmat. Raqamlarga o‘tishdan oldin, siz uchun eng muhimi nima? Ochiq savollar haqiqatan muhim narsani ochib beradi.

scenes.title: Taklif va savdolashish
board: Propose: We’d like to propose...
What we can offer is...
Bargain: How flexible are you on...?
That’s a little outside our budget.
scenes.say_native: Taklifda aniq, lekin yumshoq iboralar: “We’d like to propose”, “What we can offer is”. Savdolashishda: “How flexible are you on the delivery date?”, “That’s a little outside our budget”. “We’d like” va “a little” taklifni qat’iy, lekin do‘stona qiladi. Birinchi taklifni o‘zingiz qilsangiz, boshlang‘ich nuqtani siz belgilaysiz.
scenes.say: What we can offer is a two-year contract at a fixed rate. How flexible are you on the delivery date?
scenes.say_uz: Biz taklif qila oladigan narsa: belgilangan narxda ikki yillik shartnoma. Yetkazib berish sanasi bo‘yicha qanchalik moslasha olasiz?

scenes.title: Yakunlash va tasdiqlash
board: So, to confirm: ...
Let’s put that in writing.
I think we have a deal.
I’ll send over a summary by Friday.
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi bosqich ko‘pincha unutiladi: tasdiqlash. Kelishilganni qayta aytib chiqing: “So, to confirm: two years, five per cent discount, delivery by March”. Keyin yozma qilishni taklif qiling: “I’ll send over a summary by Friday”. O‘zbek amaliyotida og‘zaki kelishuv ko‘p, ingliz ish dunyosida esa yozma tasdiq odatiy.
scenes.say: So, to confirm: two years, a five per cent discount, delivery by March. I'll send over a summary by Friday.
scenes.say_uz: Demak, tasdiqlaymiz: ikki yil, besh foiz chegirma, martgacha yetkazib berish. Juma kunigacha xulosani yuboraman.

scenes.title: Chegarani oshkor qilish
board: ✗ Our maximum budget is £10,000.
✓ What sort of figure did you have in mind?
✗ Skipping the explore stage
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: boshidayoq o‘z chegarangizni aytish. “Our maximum budget is ten thousand” deganingizdan keyin narx aynan o‘n mingga chiqadi. Uning o‘rniga: “What sort of figure did you have in mind?”. Ikkinchisi: o‘rganish bosqichini tashlab ketish. Savol bermasangiz, ular uchun nima muhimligini bilmaysiz va yon berish uchun materialingiz bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: Our maximum budget is ten thousand. Guess what the price will be now. Instead ask: What sort of figure did you have in mind?
scenes.say_uz: Bizning maksimal byudjetimiz o‘n ming. Endi narx qancha bo‘lishini taxmin qiling. Uning o‘rniga so‘rang: Qanday summani nazarda tutgandingiz?

scenes.title: Mashq: qaysi bosqich?
board: A So, just to recap what we’ve agreed...
B What’s your main priority this year?
C Thanks for coming all this way.
D How flexible are you on payment terms?
E We’d like to propose a 12-month trial.
scenes.say_native: Beshta ibora berilgan. Har biri muzokaraning qaysi bosqichiga tegishli: ochilish, o‘rganish, taklif, savdolashish yoki yakunlash? Har biriga bosqich nomini yozing. Keyin ularni muzokaradagi to‘g‘ri tartibda joylashtiring. Esda tuting, tayyorgarlik bosqichida hali stol atrofida gap yo‘q. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: Match each phrase to a stage: open, explore, propose, bargain or close. Then put them in order. Pause now.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir iborani bosqich bilan moslang: ochilish, o‘rganish, taklif, savdolashish yoki yakunlash. Keyin ularni tartiblang. Hozir pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: bosqichlar
board: C open → B explore → E propose
→ D bargain → A close
Order: C, B, E, D, A
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. C ochilish: rahmat aytish va munosabat o‘rnatish. B o‘rganish: ularning ustuvorligi haqida ochiq savol. E taklif: “We’d like to propose”. D savdolashish: to‘lov shartlari bo‘yicha moslashuvchanlikni sinash. A yakunlash: kelishilganni qayta aytish. Demak tartib: C, B, E, D, A. Agar tartib to‘g‘ri chiqqan bo‘lsa, muzokaraning tuzilishini tushungansiz.
scenes.say: C opens, B explores, E proposes, D bargains, and A closes. C, B, E, D, A.
scenes.say_uz: C ochadi, B o‘rganadi, E taklif qiladi, D savdolashadi, A yakunlaydi. C, B, E, D, A.

scenes.title: Hech qachon tekinga yon bermang
board: Concession = something you give up
Rule: trade, don’t give
Give X → get Y
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: yon berish va shartlar. Concession, ya’ni yon berish, biror narsadan voz kechish. Asosiy qoida: tekinga bermang, almashtiring. Narxni tushirsangiz, evaziga nimadir oling: uzunroq shartnoma, kattaroq buyurtma, tezroq to‘lov. Tekin yon berish ikki xato signal beradi: sizning birinchi narxingiz sun’iy edi va yana bosim qilsa, yana tushasiz.
scenes.say: Never give a concession away. Trade it. If the price comes down, something else should go up: volume, commitment or speed of payment.
scenes.say_uz: Yon berishni hech qachon tekinga bermang. Uni almashtiring. Narx tushsa, boshqa narsa oshishi kerak: hajm, majburiyat yoki to‘lov tezligi.

scenes.title: Shart: if + present, will/can
board: If you + present, we can / will...
If you commit to two years, we can reduce the price by 5%.
Condition first → concession second

examples.t: If you pay upfront, we'll include free delivery.
examples.uz: Oldindan to‘lasangiz, yetkazib berishni bepul qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Asosiy grammatik shakl: birinchi tip shart gap. If qismida hozirgi zamon, asosiy qismda will yoki can. “If you commit to two years, we can reduce the price by five per cent.” E’tibor bering: avval shart, keyin yon berish. Bu tartib psixologik jihatdan muhim: tinglovchi avval nima berishi kerakligini eshitadi, shunda yon berish sovg‘a emas, almashinuv bo‘lib tuyuladi.
scenes.say: If you commit to two years, we can reduce the price by five per cent. Condition first, concession second.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yilga majburiyat olsangiz, narxni besh foizga kamaytira olamiz. Avval shart, keyin yon berish.

scenes.title: Provided that, as long as, unless
board: provided (that) / providing = faqat ... bo‘lsa
as long as = ... bo‘lsa bo‘ldi
on condition that (formal) · unless = if not

examples.t: We can agree to that, provided that delivery is on time.
examples.uz: Yetkazib berish o‘z vaqtida bo‘lsa, bunga rozi bo‘lamiz.

examples.t: We can't go lower unless you increase the order.

scenes.say_native: If dan kuchliroq shart bog‘lovchilari. Provided that va providing: faqat shu shart bajarilsa. As long as: shu bo‘lsa bo‘ldi, biroz norasmiy. On condition that: juda rasmiy, shartnomalarda. Unless: agar ... bo‘lmasa, ya’ni “if not”. “We can’t go lower unless you increase the order” degani buyurtmani oshirmasangiz, pastroq tushmaymiz.
scenes.say: We can agree, provided that delivery is on time. We can't go lower unless you increase the order.
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazib berish o‘z vaqtida bo‘lsa, rozi bo‘lamiz. Buyurtmani oshirmasangiz, pastroq tusha olmaymiz.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkor taklif: if we were to
board: If we were to + verb, would you...?
Supposing we..., could you...?
Hypothetical = no commitment yet

examples.t: If we were to increase the order, would you consider a discount?
examples.uz: Agar buyurtmani oshirsak, chegirmani ko‘rib chiqarmidingiz?

scenes.say_native: Ba’zan siz hali va’da bermasdan, faqat suvni sinab ko‘rmoqchisiz. Buning uchun ikkinchi tip shart va “were to” shakli: “If we were to increase the order, would you consider a discount?”. “Supposing we extended the contract, could you...” ham shunday. Bu gaplar faraziy, ya’ni siz hali hech narsa bermadingiz, lekin ularning javobidan chegarasini bilib olasiz.
scenes.say: If we were to increase the order, would you consider a discount? Nothing promised, a lot learnt.
scenes.say_uz: Agar buyurtmani oshirsak, chegirmani ko‘rib chiqarmidingiz? Hech narsa va’da qilinmadi, ko‘p narsa bilib olindi.

scenes.title: Yon berish iboralari
board: I’m prepared to... in return for...
We could meet you halfway.
That’s as far as we can go.
Let’s split the difference.
scenes.say_native: Yon berish uchun tayyor iboralar. “I’m prepared to lower the price in return for a longer contract”: almashinuv aniq. “We could meet you halfway”: yarim yo‘lda uchrashish. “Let’s split the difference”: farqni teng bo‘lish. “That’s as far as we can go”: bu oxirgi chegara, endi yon bermaymiz. Oxirgi iborani faqat haqiqatan chegarada ishlating, aks holda ishonchingiz yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: I'm prepared to lower the price in return for a longer contract. We could meet you halfway. But that's as far as we can go.
scenes.say_uz: Uzunroq shartnoma evaziga narxni tushirishga tayyorman. Yarim yo‘lda uchrashishimiz mumkin. Lekin bu biz bora oladigan oxirgi chegara.

scenes.title: If va provided dan keyin will
board: ✗ If you will pay upfront, we will...
✓ If you pay upfront, we will...
✗ provided that you will sign
✓ provided that you sign
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tilida shart qismida kelasi zamon ma’nosi bor: “to‘lasangiz”, “если вы заплатите”. Shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “if you will pay” deydi. Xato. If, provided that, as long as, unless dan keyin hozirgi zamon: “if you pay”, “provided that you sign”. Will faqat asosiy qismda.
scenes.say: If you will pay upfront: wrong. If you pay upfront, we'll include delivery. Provided that you sign today. No will after if or provided that.
scenes.say_uz: If you will pay upfront: xato. If you pay upfront, we'll include delivery. Provided that you sign today. If yoki provided that dan keyin will yo‘q.

scenes.title: Mashq: shartli taklif tuzing
board: 1 discount 10% ← order 500 units (if)
2 free training ← sign this month (provided that)
3 no price cut ← longer contract (unless)
4 test the water: faster delivery? (if we were to)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vazifa. Har birida yon berish va shart berilgan, qavs ichida esa qaysi bog‘lovchini ishlatish kerakligi. To‘liq, tabiiy gap tuzing. Esda tuting: shart qismida will yo‘q. To‘rtinchisida faraziy savol tuzing, ya’ni hali hech narsa va’da qilmang. Pauza qiling va ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Build four conditional offers using the linker in brackets. The last one should be a hypothetical question. Pause now.
scenes.say_uz: Qavs ichidagi bog‘lovchi bilan to‘rtta shartli taklif tuzing. Oxirgisi faraziy savol bo‘lsin. Hozir pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: shartli takliflar
board: 1 If you order 500 units, we can offer 10% off.
2 We’ll include free training, provided that you sign this month.
3 We can’t cut the price unless you agree to a longer contract.
4 If we were to pay faster, would you deliver sooner?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “If you order five hundred units, we can offer ten per cent off”. Ikkinchi: “We’ll include free training, provided that you sign this month”. Uchinchi: “We can’t cut the price unless you agree to a longer contract”. To‘rtinchi: “If we were to pay faster, would you deliver sooner?”. Shart qismlarida will yo‘qligini tekshiring.
scenes.say: If you order five hundred units, we can offer ten per cent off. No will after if.
scenes.say_uz: Besh yuz dona buyurtma qilsangiz, o‘n foiz chegirma bera olamiz. If dan keyin will yo‘q.

scenes.title: Diplomatik til nima uchun kerak?
board: Firm on the issue, soft on the person
Softeners: I’m afraid · a little · slightly
quite · perhaps · it seems
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: diplomatik til. Qoida: masala bo‘yicha qat’iy, inson bilan yumshoq. Siz “yo‘q” deyishingiz mumkin, lekin munosabatni buzmasdan. Buning uchun yumshatuvchilar: “I’m afraid”, “a little”, “slightly”, “perhaps”, “it seems”. Ular ma’noni o‘zgartirmaydi, faqat ohangni yumshatadi. Oldingi darsdan eslang: bu hedge lar, faqat endi ularni o‘zingiz ishlatasiz.
scenes.say: Be firm on the issue and soft on the person. I'm afraid that's slightly higher than we expected. Still a no, but a no you can keep talking after.
scenes.say_uz: Masala bo‘yicha qat’iy, inson bilan yumshoq bo‘ling. Afsuski, bu biz kutganimizdan biroz yuqori. Baribir “yo‘q”, lekin undan keyin ham suhbatni davom ettirsa bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘tgan zamon orqali yumshatish
board: I was wondering if you could...
We were hoping for something closer to...
I wanted to ask about...

examples.t: We were hoping for something closer to £50,000.
examples.uz: Biz ellik ming funtga yaqinroq narsani umid qilgandik.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida o‘tgan zamon, ayniqsa davomli o‘tgan zamon, hozirgi iltimosni yumshatadi. “I was wondering if you could extend the deadline” hozirgi iltimos, lekin “I wonder” yoki “Can you” dan ancha yumshoq. “We were hoping for something closer to fifty thousand” esa talabni xohish sifatida beradi. O‘zbek tilidagi “-moqchi edim” shakliga o‘xshaydi: “so‘ramoqchi edim”.
scenes.say: I was wondering if you could extend the deadline. We were hoping for something closer to fifty thousand. The past makes the present polite.
scenes.say_uz: Muddatni uzaytira olasizmi, deb so‘ramoqchi edim. Biz ellik mingga yaqinroq narsani umid qilgandik. O‘tgan zamon hozirgini muloyim qiladi.

scenes.title: Inkor savol va modallar
board: Wouldn’t it make more sense to...?
Couldn’t we look at...?
It might be worth considering...

examples.t: Wouldn't it make more sense to start with a pilot?

scenes.say_native: Taklifni buyruq emas, savol sifatida bering. Inkor savol: “Wouldn’t it make more sense to start with a pilot?”, “Couldn’t we look at the timeline again?”. Bu shakl tinglovchini rozilikka undaydi, lekin majburlamaydi. Modal bilan: “It might be worth considering a phased approach”. “You should” o‘rniga “it might be worth” ishlatsangiz, taklif sizniki emas, umumiy aql kabi eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Wouldn't it make more sense to start with a pilot? It might be worth considering a phased approach. Suggestions, not orders.
scenes.say_uz: Pilot loyihadan boshlash mantiqliroq emasmi? Bosqichma-bosqich yondashuvni ko‘rib chiqishga arzishi mumkin. Buyruq emas, taklif.

scenes.title: Britancha “yo‘q” ni tushunish
board: That could be tricky. = probably no
I’ll bear it in mind. = probably forget it
With respect... = I disagree strongly
Interesting idea. = I’m not convinced
scenes.say_native: Diplomatik tilni tushunish ham kerak. Britaniyalik hamkor “That could be tricky” desa, bu ko‘pincha yo‘q. “I’ll bear it in mind” ko‘pincha unutaman degani. “With respect” dan keyin odatda keskin norozilik keladi. Kontekst muhim, lekin bu iboralarni rozilik deb qabul qilmang.
scenes.say: That could be tricky. I'll bear it in mind. With respect, I see it differently. Polite on the surface, but often a firm no underneath.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin. Yodimda tutaman. Hurmat bilan, men buni boshqacha ko‘raman. Ustidan muloyim, lekin ko‘pincha ostida qat’iy “yo‘q”.

scenes.title: Shaxssizlashtirish
board: ✗ Your figures are wrong.
✓ The figures don’t seem to add up.
✓ There seems to be a misunderstanding.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir diplomatik usul: muammoni insondan ajratish. “Your figures are wrong” ayblov. “The figures don’t seem to add up” esa muammo raqamlarda, siz emas. “You misunderstood” o‘rniga “There seems to be a misunderstanding”. Ega sifatida “you” emas, narsa yoki vaziyat turadi va “seem” yumshatadi. Shunda qarshi tomon himoyaga o‘tmaydi va muammoni birga hal qilasiz.
scenes.say: Your figures are wrong becomes the figures don't seem to add up. You misunderstood becomes there seems to be a misunderstanding.
scenes.say_uz: Raqamlaringiz noto‘g‘ri o‘rniga raqamlar bir-biriga to‘g‘ri kelmayotganga o‘xshaydi. Siz noto‘g‘ri tushundingiz o‘rniga tushunmovchilik bor shekilli.

scenes.title: Juda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri
board: ✗ No. Your price is too high.
✓ I’m afraid that’s a little higher than we expected.
✗ We want 20% discount.
✓ We were hoping for something nearer 20%.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “narxingiz baland” deyish oddiy bo‘lishi mumkin, ayniqsa bozorda. Lekin ingliz ish muhitida “No. Your price is too high” juda keskin eshitiladi va suhbat sovib qoladi. Bir xil fikrni “I’m afraid that’s a little higher than we expected” deb ayting. “We want twenty per cent” o‘rniga “We were hoping for something nearer twenty per cent”. Pozitsiya o‘sha, ohang boshqa.
scenes.say: No. Your price is too high. Ouch. Instead: I'm afraid that's a little higher than we'd expected. Same position, much better atmosphere.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q. Narxingiz juda baland. Og‘riqli. Uning o‘rniga: Afsuski, bu biz kutganimizdan biroz yuqori. Pozitsiya o‘sha, muhit ancha yaxshi.

scenes.title: Mashq: diplomatik qiling
board: 1 Your deadline is impossible.
2 We want a better price.
3 You didn’t send the report.
4 You should hire more staff.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta keskin gap. Har birini diplomatik qiling. Yumshatuvchilar, o‘tgan zamon, shaxssizlashtirish va inkor savoldan foydalaning. Har bir gapda kamida bitta usul bo‘lsin, lekin ma’no o‘zgarmasin: siz baribir o‘z pozitsiyangizni saqlaysiz. Pauza qiling va ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Make each sentence diplomatic without changing your position. Use softeners, the past, impersonal subjects or a negative question. Pause now.
scenes.say_uz: Pozitsiyani o‘zgartirmasdan har bir gapni diplomatik qiling. Yumshatuvchi, o‘tgan zamon, shaxssiz ega yoki inkor savoldan foydalaning. Hozir pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: diplomatik til
board: 1 I’m afraid that deadline might be a little tight.
2 We were hoping for a slightly better price.
3 The report doesn’t seem to have arrived yet.
4 Wouldn’t it make sense to bring in more staff?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “I’m afraid that deadline might be a little tight”, yumshatuvchilar. Ikkinchi: “We were hoping for a slightly better price”, o‘tgan zamon. Uchinchi: “The report doesn’t seem to have arrived yet”, ayb sizda emas, hisobotda. To‘rtinchi: “Wouldn’t it make sense to bring in more staff?”, inkor savol. Har birida pozitsiya saqlandi.
scenes.say: I'm afraid that deadline might be a little tight. The report doesn't seem to have arrived yet.
scenes.say_uz: Afsuski, bu muddat biroz siqiq bo‘lishi mumkin. Hisobot hali yetib kelmaganga o‘xshaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u va ohang
board: Contrastive stress: We can’t do TWO years, but we could do ONE.
Fall ↘ = firm: That’s our final offer.
Fall-rise ↘↗ = reservation: It’s possible...
scenes.say_native: Muzokarada ohang ham ma’no beradi. Qarama-qarshi urg‘u: “We can’t do TWO years, but we could do ONE”. Tushuvchi ohang qat’iylikni bildiradi: “That’s our final offer”. Tushib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang esa shart yoki shubha bor degani: “It’s possible...”, tinglovchi “but” ni kutadi. “We could” da could kuchsiz /kəd/ bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: We can't do two years, but we could do one. That's our final offer. It's possible... Hear how stress and tone carry the message.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yil qila olmaymiz, lekin bir yil qila olamiz. Bu bizning oxirgi taklifimiz. Bu mumkin... Urg‘u va ohang xabarni qanday tashishini eshiting.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: yetkazib beruvchi bilan
board: Listen: a buyer and a supplier negotiate
Focus: conditions, concessions, the final deal
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Xaridor Laura va yetkazib beruvchi Rustam narx haqida muzokara qilmoqda. Diqqat qiling: qanday shartlar qo‘yiladi, kim nimadan yon beradi va oxirida qanday kelishuvga erishiladi? Shuningdek diplomatik iboralarni sanab boring va har bir yon berish evaziga nima olinganini kuzating.
scenes.say: Laura: I'm afraid twelve pounds a unit is a little higher than we'd expected. Rustam: I understand. What sort of figure did you have in mind? Laura: Something nearer ten. Rustam: Ten would be tricky. But if you were to order two thousand units, we could do eleven. Laura: Two thousand is a big commitment. Could we split it into two deliveries? Rustam: Provided that you pay the first invoice within thirty days, yes. Laura: Then I think we have a deal. Rustam: Great. I'll send over a summary today.
scenes.say_uz: Laura: Afsuski, bir dona uchun o‘n ikki funt biz kutganimizdan biroz yuqori. Rustam: Tushunaman. Qanday summani nazarda tutgandingiz? Laura: O‘nga yaqinroq. Rustam: O‘n qiyin bo‘ladi. Lekin ikki ming dona buyurtma qilsangiz, o‘n bir qila olamiz. Laura: Ikki ming katta majburiyat. Ikkita yetkazib berishga bo‘lsak bo‘ladimi? Rustam: Birinchi hisobni o‘ttiz kun ichida to‘lasangiz, ha. Laura: Unda kelishdik deb o‘ylayman. Rustam: Zo‘r. Bugun xulosani yuboraman.

scenes.title: Savollar: 1-tinglash
board: 1 What is the final price per unit?
2 What did Rustam ask for in return?
3 What condition did he set for split delivery?
4 Find two diplomatic phrases.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Bir dona uchun yakuniy narx qancha? Rustam narxni tushirish evaziga nima so‘radi? Yetkazib berishni ikkiga bo‘lish uchun qanday shart qo‘ydi? Va dialogdan ikkita diplomatik iborani toping. Esda tuting, “tricky” so‘zi ham diplomatik signal. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: What's the final price? What did Rustam want in return? What condition did he set? And find two diplomatic phrases. Pause now.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy narx qancha? Rustam evaziga nima so‘radi? Qanday shart qo‘ydi? Va ikkita diplomatik iborani toping. Hozir pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: 1-tinglash
board: 1 £11 per unit
2 An order of 2,000 units
3 Pay the first invoice within 30 days
4 I’m afraid... a little higher · Ten would be tricky
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: bir dona o‘n bir funt. Ikkinchi: Rustam evaziga ikki ming dona buyurtma so‘radi, tekinga yon bermadi. Uchinchi: birinchi hisobni o‘ttiz kun ichida to‘lash, bu yerda “provided that” ishlatildi. To‘rtinchi: “I’m afraid ... a little higher than we’d expected” va “Ten would be tricky”.
scenes.say: Eleven pounds a unit, for an order of two thousand. Every concession was traded.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki ming dona buyurtma evaziga bir dona o‘n bir funt. Har bir yon berish almashinuv edi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: maosh muzokarasi
board: Listen: Aziz negotiates his salary with HR
Focus: persuasion, BATNA, the final package
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash, uy vazifangiz uchun namuna. Aziz kadrlar bo‘limi menejeri Claire bilan maoshi haqida gaplashmoqda. Diqqat qiling: Aziz qanday dalillar keltiradi, u qanday BATNA ga ishora qiladi, talabini qanday yumshatadi va oxirida qanday paket kelishiladi?
scenes.say: Aziz: Thanks for making the time, Claire. This year I've led three projects, all delivered early, and the Tashkent client renewed for two years. Claire: We're very pleased with your work. Aziz: Thanks. So I was hoping for something closer to forty-five thousand. I've also had an approach elsewhere. Claire: Forty-five might be difficult this year. We could do forty-two, plus an extra five days' leave. Aziz: If we were to review it again in six months, I could accept forty-two. Claire: That sounds fair.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz: Vaqt ajratganingiz uchun rahmat, Kler. O‘tgan yil uchta loyihani boshqardim, hammasi muddatidan oldin topshirildi va Toshkentdagi mijoz shartnomani ikki yilga uzaytirdi. Kler: Ishingizdan juda mamnunmiz. Aziz: Rahmat. Shuning uchun qirq besh mingga yaqinroq narsani umid qilgandim. Boshqa joydan ham taklif tushdi. Kler: Bu yil qirq besh qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin. Qirq ikki va qo‘shimcha besh kunlik ta’til bera olamiz. Aziz: Agar olti oydan keyin yana ko‘rib chiqsak, qirq ikkini qabul qila olaman. Kler: Bu adolatli.

scenes.title: Savollar: 2-tinglash
board: 1 What evidence does Aziz give? (logos)
2 What is his BATNA?
3 What is the final package?
4 Which form does Aziz use to soften his request?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Aziz qanday dalillar keltiradi, ya’ni uning logosi nima? Uning BATNA si nima? Yakuniy paket nimadan iborat? Va Aziz o‘z talabini qaysi grammatik shakl bilan yumshatdi? Oxirgi savol uchun diplomatik til qismini, ayniqsa o‘tgan zamon orqali yumshatishni eslang. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: What evidence does Aziz give? What's his BATNA? What's the final package? And how does he soften his request? Pause now.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz qanday dalil keltiradi? Uning BATNA si nima? Yakuniy paket qanday? Va u talabini qanday yumshatadi? Hozir pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: 2-tinglash
board: 1 Three projects delivered early; a client renewed for two years
2 An approach from elsewhere (another job offer)
3 £42,000 + 5 extra days’ leave + review in 6 months
4 Past continuous: I was hoping for...
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: uchta loyiha muddatidan oldin topshirilgan va mijoz ikki yilga uzaytirgan, aniq dalillar. Ikkinchi: boshqa joydan kelgan taklif, bu uning BATNA si, u buni tahdidsiz, yumshoq aytdi. Uchinchi: qirq ikki ming, besh kun qo‘shimcha ta’til va olti oydan keyin qayta ko‘rib chiqish. To‘rtinchi: “I was hoping for”.
scenes.say: Forty-two thousand, five extra days' leave, and a review in six months.
scenes.say_uz: Qirq ikki ming, besh kun qo‘shimcha ta’til va olti oydan keyin qayta ko‘rib chiqish.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: o‘z taklifingiz
board: Speak for 60 seconds:
1 Open politely  2 Two pieces of evidence
3 Your request, softened  4 One conditional concession
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Tasavvur qiling, siz rahbaringiz bilan maosh yoki ish sharoiti haqida gaplashyapsiz. Bir daqiqa gapiring. Xushmuomala ochilish qiling, ikkita aniq dalil keltiring, talabingizni yumshatib ayting va bitta shartli yon berish taklif qiling. Agar imkon bo‘lsa, o‘zingizni yozib oling.
scenes.say: Open politely, give two pieces of evidence, soften your request and offer one conditional concession.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim oching, ikkita dalil keltiring, talabni yumshating va bitta shartli yon berish taklif qiling.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Thanks for seeing me. This year I trained four new staff
and cut reporting time by a third.
I was hoping we could discuss a move to senior level.
If that’s possible, I’d be happy to take on the new client.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobni tahlil qiling. Ochilish: “Thanks for seeing me”. Ikkita dalil: to‘rtta yangi xodimni o‘qitdim va hisobot vaqtini uchdan birga qisqartirdim. Yumshatilgan talab: “I was hoping we could discuss a move to senior level”. Shartli yon berish: “If that’s possible, I’d be happy to take on the new client”. To‘rt qism ham bormi? Unda siz C1 darajasida muzokara qilyapsiz.
scenes.say: Thanks for seeing me. I was hoping we could discuss a move to senior level. If that's possible, I'd be happy to take on the new client.
scenes.say_uz: Meni qabul qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Katta lavozimga o‘tishni muhokama qilsak deb umid qilgandim. Agar bu mumkin bo‘lsa, yangi mijozni zimmamga olishdan xursand bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: Persuade: ethos, logos, pathos · benefits · rule of three
Stages: prepare, open, explore, propose, bargain, close
Concessions: trade · if / provided that / unless
Diplomacy: firm on the issue, soft on the person
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: ishonchlilik, dalil va his-tuyg‘uni birlashtiring, xususiyat emas, foyda haqida gapiring. Ikkinchi: oltita bosqichni, ayniqsa o‘rganishni o‘tkazib yubormang. Uchinchi: yon berishni if, provided that, unless bilan almashtiring, shart qismida will yo‘q. To‘rtinchi: masala bo‘yicha qat’iy, inson bilan yumshoq bo‘ling.
scenes.say: Persuade with evidence and benefits. Trade every concession. Stay firm on the issue, soft on the person.
scenes.say_uz: Dalil va foyda bilan ishontiring. Har bir yon berishni almashtiring. Masala bo‘yicha qat’iy, inson bilan yumshoq bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: Role-play a salary negotiation
Success: all 6 stages · 2 pieces of evidence
2 conditional concessions · 3 diplomatic phrases
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: do‘stingiz yoki hamkasbingiz bilan yaxshiroq maosh uchun muzokarani rolli o‘yin sifatida o‘tkazing, uni yozib oling. Mezon: oltita bosqichning hammasi bo‘lsin, kamida ikkita aniq dalil, ikkita shartli yon berish va uchta diplomatik ibora ishlating, oxirida kelishuvni qayta aytib tasdiqlang. Keyingi darsda gapni boshqacha ifodalash, ya’ni parafrazni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: role-play a salary negotiation and record it. Next time: paraphrasing.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: maosh muzokarasini rolli o‘yin qilib, yozib oling. Keyingi dars: parafraz.

homework_uz: Do‘stingiz yoki hamkasbingiz bilan yaxshiroq maosh uchun muzokarani rolli o‘yin sifatida o‘tkazing (5–7 daqiqa) va yozib oling. Mezon: oltita bosqichning hammasi bo‘lsin, kamida ikkita aniq dalil, ikkita shartli yon berish (if, provided that yoki unless) va uchta diplomatik ibora ishlating, shart qismida will ishlatmang va oxirida kelishuvni qayta aytib tasdiqlang.

options: If you will pay upfront, we will include delivery.
If you pay upfront, we will include delivery.
If you paid upfront, we will include delivery.
If you pay upfront, we include will delivery.
quiz.why_uz: If qismida hozirgi zamon, will faqat asosiy qismda.

quiz.q: Which is the most diplomatic way to reject a price?
options: I'm afraid that's a little higher than we expected.
quiz.why_uz: I'm afraid va a little ohangni yumshatadi, pozitsiya esa saqlanadi.

quiz.q: “We can't lower the price ___ you increase the order.”

options: your best alternative if there is no deal
quiz.why_uz: BATNA = kelishuv bo‘lmasa eng yaxshi muqobilingiz.

quiz.q: Which stage includes “What's most important to you here?”
quiz.why_uz: Ochiq savol bilan qiziqishlarni o‘rganish bosqichi.

quiz.q: “If we were to extend the contract, would you lower the rate?” This sentence is:
quiz.why_uz: Were to faraziy: hali hech narsa va’da qilinmagan.

quiz.q: A British partner says “That could be tricky.” This most likely means:
Which sentence turns a feature into a benefit?
options: The app has a dark mode.
This means your team will save two hours a week.
quiz.why_uz: This means you'll/your team will tinglovchining foydasini ko‘rsatadi.

quiz.q: Which is the best way to make a request softer?
options: I was hoping we could discuss my salary.
quiz.why_uz: Davomli o‘tgan zamon (I was hoping) iltimosni muloyim qiladi.

quiz.q: What is the golden rule of concessions?
options: Give them early to build trust
Trade them for something in return
